rationale:
SUBMITTED WITH FORCE=1, AND THAT IS THE POINT OF THE CHANGE. Every edit here is outside the review scope even AFTER this fix: the 097/098 scripts live under docs/, the fragment and the nudge under scripts/, and this widening deliberately admits appliable MIGRATIONS only, not tooling. So the gate refuses its own repair. An unexplained force is indistinguishable from someone dodging the filter, so this is the informed kind, and LANDMINES prescribes saying so here in the first paragraph. Please review it as tooling that decides admission, not as a platform-behaviour change.

THE DEFECT (bugs_open/314). 097_TRIGGER_council_review_v1.sh:87 carried SCOPE_RE='^(platform|internal|pkg)/' and refused any submission whose edits all sat under docs/ - including docs/agent_docs/sql_for_agents/NNN_name.sql, which is where this estate's LIVE agent config ships. The owner ruling it quotes (2026-07-17) is about SUBJECT MATTER - prose does not spend council credits - but it was implemented as a PATH test. A migration is not prose: it rewrites what a live agent does, is live the moment it applies, and has no image tag to roll back, so it reaches production faster than any Go change. Measured in the bug: 152 of 227 (67%) migration-shipping commits over a fortnight were config-only and therefore unreviewable without FORCE=1. And the filter is inverted with respect to value: bug section 9 records three rounds from another lane where the two config-only rounds (refused by the gate) drew a HIGH-severity gating objection that materially changed the artefact, while the in-scope Go round drew ZERO objections.

WHY THIS IS NOT THE ONE-LINE WIDENING THE BUG SKETCHED. The bug names one file; there were THREE hand-maintained copies of the scope - 097:87 (admission), council-coverage-nudge.sh:58 (the commit-msg nudge) and 098:76 (the coverage report, as a git pathspec). Widening one and leaving two is how a rule becomes folklore: the gate would admit migrations while the nudge stayed silent on them and the report kept mis-bucketing them. So: ONE definition (scripts/council-scope.sh), three callers, with the differing FAILURE SEMANTICS at each call site - 097 fails LOUD on a missing fragment (exit 1, deliberately NOT the refusal's exit 2: with no scope it must neither admit prose nor lock everyone out), the nudge exits 0 SILENTLY (advisory, must never block a commit), 098 fails LOUD (a report against an unknown scope is worse than none). All three branches were induced in a scratch repo, not reasoned about.

THE ONE COPY WE DID NOT ABSORB, DELIBERATELY. The migration vocabulary belongs to scripts/migration/run-migrations.sh (SIDECAR_RE :65, the appliable-name grep :283). Sourcing the fragment FROM the runner was considered and rejected: it would couple the review gate to the APPLY path, so a syntax error in the gate's fragment would stop migrations applying - a bigger blast radius than the bug. Instead the fragment holds verbatim copies, guarded by council_scope_drift_warn(), a grep -qF verbatim-anchor check that WARNs on every 097/098 run (11-43 times a day, so it cannot sit silent) and can never block one. Proven both ways: silent against the real runner, WARNs against a doctored copy.

COST, because the bug's section 5 explicitly asked that someone price this before it went in. Council-gate volume measured 2026-08-19 from llm_call_log: 11-43 runs/day over 9 days (median ~24-33). Worst case if every config-only commit became a round: +11/day. Realistic, at one round per coherent task spanning several commits: +4-6/day, i.e. +15-25%. Two mitigations are already live: prompt caching since v1.0.1283 at a measured 74% saving (council_gate_cost lane), and relevance gating - only footprint-matching seats fire beyond the two always-on ones. TRIPWIRE, stated rather than assumed: if sustained volume exceeds 150% of the 9-day median for a fortnight, raise fix candidate 2 (a cheaper config-specific seat set) as a follow-up - do NOT revert admission.

RFC QUESTION (owner ruling 2026-07-29 section 1), answered rather than left for you: NO RFC. The trigger is a change to what the shared mechanism GUARANTEES. The gate's guarantees are untouched - an admitted submission still gets a full round, verdict artefacts still key on the correlation, the trailer and 098 join semantics are unchanged. What changes is ADMISSION POLICY. Ruling section 3 (other consumers must be TOLD, not merely measured) is discharged by edits 5-7: CLAUDE.md, the council RUNBOOK amendment and the LANDMINES correction ARE the telling.

PROCESS, stated: no 090 diagnosis-loop run, deliberately (owner ruling 2026-07-31). The mechanism is four lines of shell read at source; the bug's own section 7 records the same substitution for the filing; the population figure is one git log loop any reader can re-run. Nothing structural is asserted that a loop would test.

plan.summary: The council gate's admission filter is a path regex that classifies this estate's live DB config (docs/agent_docs/sql_for_agents/NNN_name.sql) as prose and refuses it, so 67% of migration-shipping commits can only be reviewed with FORCE=1. Fix: extract the scope to a single sourced fragment (scripts/council-scope.sh) consumed by all three copies - the 097 admission gate, the commit-msg nudge and the 098 coverage report - and widen it to admit APPLIABLE migrations while still refusing prose, site content and the hand-run _ROLLBACK/_VERIFY/_HOLD sidecars. Adds DRY_RUN=1 to 097 so admission is testable without spending credits. Docs edits tell the three other consumers of the rule.

edits.rationale: The single source. Three hand-maintained copies of one matching rule is the drift class this estate keeps filing bugs about (099 roster mirror; dedup-index/Go-list lockstep; pattern-check's own check_register_coverage docstring says 'There is one implementation; this calls it'). Two arms ORed, migration arm is match-then-reject-sidecar - the runner's own idiom at :283-284 - because a trailing-_TOKEN negative class is unwritable in ERE, and keeping the arms separate stops the sidecar rule knocking out a platform/ path. Every grep carries || true because 097/098 run under set -euo pipefail and a no-match grep exits 1.
edits.sketch:
COUNCIL_SCOPE_CODE_RE='^(platform|internal|pkg)/'
COUNCIL_SCOPE_MIGRATION_RE='^docs/agent_docs/sql_for_agents/[0-9]{3}_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.sql$'
COUNCIL_SCOPE_SIDECAR_RE='_[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*\.sql$'

in_council_scope() {   # paths on stdin -> in-scope paths on stdout
  local paths; paths=$(cat)
  [ -n "$paths" ] || return 0
  {
    printf '%s\n' "$paths" | grep -E  "$COUNCIL_SCOPE_CODE_RE"      || true
    printf '%s\n' "$paths" | grep -E  "$COUNCIL_SCOPE_MIGRATION_RE" \
                           | grep -vE "$COUNCIL_SCOPE_SIDECAR_RE"   || true
  } | sort -u
  return 0
}

council_scope_drift_warn() {   # $1 = repo root; WARNS only, never blocks
  local runner="${1:-}/scripts/migration/run-migrations.sh"
  [ -f "$runner" ] || return 0
  if ! grep -qF "SIDECAR_RE='_[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*\\.sql\$'" "$runner" \
     || ! grep -qF "grep -E '^[0-9]{3}_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\\.sql\$'" "$runner"; then
    echo "WARN: council scope's migration vocabulary no longer matches run-migrations.sh (:65, :283) — reconcile scripts/council-scope.sh (bugs_open/314)." >&2
  fi
  return 0
}

edits.rationale: The admission gate. Sources the fragment and fails LOUD if absent - exit 1, NOT the refusal's exit 2, because 'I cannot tell' must not be reported as a scope decision. The jq test becomes the two-arm form. The refusal message now names the widened scope honestly (a message that still said 'docs and site content' after the widening would mislead the next author). DRY_RUN=1 exits after all validation and the scope check but before minting a correlation, which is what makes the bug's required POSITIVE control free - previously only the negatives could be tested, so the filter could only ever be half-checked.

edits.rationale: The advisory commit-msg hook, and the one consumer that must fail SAFE: it runs on every commit in every session, so a bug here could block the fleet committing. Existence-check then source-guard then a command -v check, each exiting 0 silently; the file's existing trap 'exit 0' ERR stays as a second net. Without this edit the nudge would stay silent on exactly the config commits the gate now admits - the norm would be advertised and then not reinforced where it bites.

-        | grep -E '^(platform|internal|pkg)/' || true)

edits.rationale: The coverage report must count the same population the gate admits, or it accuses threads of skipping a review the gate never offered. A git PATHSPEC cannot express 'NNN_name.sql but not the sidecars' (wildmatch [A-Z] over-matches interior capitals), so the pathspec deliberately OVER-selects the directory and the exact predicate is applied as a post-filter per commit - stated in the header rather than hidden. One extra git plumbing call per candidate commit; the loop already runs git show -s per commit. Fails LOUD on a missing fragment.

'And the 33% pass for the wrong reason: the check is length > 0, so a submission whose Go half is one line and whose config half rewrites a fleet-wide scheduled task is admitted on the one line.'

CLAUDE.md owner ruling 2026-07-29 section 1: an addition to a shared vocabulary needs an RFC 'only when it changes what the shared mechanism GUARANTEES — not merely because the vocabulary is shared'. Section 3: 'A shared mechanism's OTHER consumers must be told, not merely measured.'

Control matrix run 2026-08-19 before submitting: 4 negatives (prose .md, _ROLLBACK.sql, _HOLD.sql, README.md in the migrations dir) all REFUSED exit 2; 2 positives (a real NNN_*.sql migration, and a platform/*.go regression case) both ADMITTED exit 0 with no FORCE; the DISCONFIRMING arm - the same migration submission against git show HEAD:097 (pre-fix) - REFUSED exit 2. Fail-semantics induced in a scratch repo with the fragment absent: 097 exit 1 loud (not 2), 098 exit 1 loud, nudge exit 0 with zero bytes of output. Drift guard silent against the real runner, WARNs against a doctored copy. 098 over the same 14-day window: 411 -> 547 in-scope commits, UNREVIEWED 69 -> 149; three 494_*_HOLD.sql-only commits correctly excluded by the post-filter, migration commit 5315c8a19 correctly included.
plan.risks: A regex error in the fragment is the worst case: it is now the single point of decision for admission, so a mistake could refuse every submission (locking threads out of review) or admit prose (spending credits on docs). Mitigated by the control matrix above - four negatives, two positives, and the pre-fix disconfirming arm - all run before submitting, and by DRY_RUN making those controls repeatable for free by the next person who touches it. Reviewers should check the two-arm jq expression against the shell in_council_scope() for semantic drift: they are separate implementations of the same rule in different dialects (jq/Oniguruma vs POSIX ERE), which is a real if small duplication we chose over passing shell output through jq. SECOND: the nudge runs from commit-msg on every commit in every session, so a sourcing bug there could block the fleet committing - mitigated by existence-check, source-guard and command -v, each exiting 0 silently, plus the pre-existing trap 'exit 0' ERR; please read that specific path adversarially. THIRD: the runner remains a second copy of the migration vocabulary, held only by grep -qF verbatim anchors - a harmless reformat of run-migrations.sh:65 or :283 will WARN until someone reconciles it, which is the intended cost, but reviewers should confirm the anchors are byte-identical to the runner today. FOURTH: 098's reported population changes (411 -> 547 over 14 days), so anyone comparing a new report against an old one is comparing different denominators - the header now states the scope and its date. FIFTH, volume: +15-25% council rounds realistically, with the 150%-of-median tripwire and fix candidate 2 named as the response rather than reverting admission. SIXTH, out of remit and recorded rather than fixed: a FOURTH copy of the migration vocabulary exists at pattern-check.py:384-385 (MIGRATION_NAME = ^\d{3}_[a-z0-9_]+\.sql$, lowercase-only) which is an idempotency lint, not a scope consumer, and is ALREADY drifted from the runner - a runner-valid migration with an interior capital is invisible to it.
